notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. Size C 900 (D 1200 also tabled; no A or B): side 900 drawn as the bounding square 1272.79, r 60, yellow edge 12 + black border 24. The sheet's vectors are to scale; table C: d 480, e 96, f 159, g 225, h 105, k 396. Symbol: the sheet PDF's own vector artwork (tools/symbols/qld_w7-13-q01-1_legend.svg, items 109-121), placed as the sheet draws it: 950.9 x 950.9 with its box 475.3 left / 475.6 right of the vertical centreline and 475.3 above / 475.6 below the horizontal centreline. Black on retroreflective yellow.
